heading: Designation of chapter
lead: This chapter shall be known as the “Trading with the enemy 1 Act.”

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This chapter, referred to in text, was in the original “this Act”, meaning act Oct. 6, 1917, ch. 106, 40 Stat. 411, known as the Trading with the enemy Act, also known as the Trading with the Enemy Act, which is classified principally to this chapter. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Tables.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 1 of the former Appendix to this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
